title: Finish Your Payment Emails Cannot Be Disabled and Are NOT Automatic Invoice Reminders
text: I do not use Automatic Invoice Reminders. They are disabled on my account. Despite this, QuickBooks sends my customers a Finish your payment email approximately 48 hours after I send their invoice, even though our invoices have Net 30 payment terms. Disabling Online automatically follows up does not stop it. The only method I have found that stops these emails is changing Online Delivery to Plain Text Only, which removes invoice tracking. Where is the setting to independently disable it?
